jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / game clothing cutout.
Create a production-ready transparent raster item atlas, four equal columns by three equal rows, with exactly TWELVE isolated clothing cutouts. Please make a high resolution 2048 by 2048 PNG with real alpha transparency, no background color or checkerboard. Every cutout stays inside its own cell with generous clear gutters. NO grid lines, text, labels, hangers, stands, mannequin bodies, people, skin, scenery, pedestals or drop shadows.
Input images 1, 2, 3 are the exact original clothing design references, in row order; retain their original rich colors, materials and construction, not simplified icons. Render polished luminous painterly-realistic 3D fantasy apparel with visible woven fabric, dimensional folds, gold thread, translucent stones, tiny stitching and satin lining matching the references.
ROW 1 is coat-dawn: original pale sage-mint SHORT shoulder cape, ivory satin lining, fine gold piping and leaf embroideries, golden leaf clasp and translucent dangling leaf jewel, opening between front panels. It ends around the wearer's waist/upper hip; do not lengthen into a robe.
ROW 2 is coat-herb: original deep forest-green LONG travel cloak to mid calf, sculpted pointed leaf-mantle shoulders, olive/ivory botanical-print lining, fine gold vine embroidery, dimensional gold leaf clasp. This is a long hanging garment, not a short cape; show its full draped lower skirt and lining.
ROW 3 is coat-star: original full-length rich violet velvet LONG star cloak, lavender satin lining, angular lilac embroidered collar, gold star-map stitchwork, sweeping hem, long gem-and-star clasp chains. Keep the elegant full length.
COLUMN order from left to right is FRONT, BACK, TRUE RIGHT SIDE, TRUE LEFT SIDE. The BACK view shows the outside back of the same garment, not a second front with its opening. The two side views must be independently rendered physical views of the same design and clasp construction, not mirrored front cutouts. Front corresponds to an upright wearer facing the camera; right profile corresponds to wearer facing screen-right, left profile to screen-left. All views have natural human shoulder and torso proportions but an entirely invisible wearer: only the garment exists. The inside of the neck opening and any space between separate garment panels must remain truly transparent. Fabric can occupy the open center when it is the actual rear lining. Clothing is at rest, hanging naturally with restrained elegant curve. Keep the two long cloaks clearly long, the morning cape short, while preserving excellent large detailed rendering within each cell. Frame every complete hem and jewel without clipping. Bright neutral studio lighting, real alpha edge, no grey fog.

Use case: identity-preserve / animated game equipment sprites.
Create a high resolution 2048 by 1536 transparent PNG sprite atlas with four equal columns and three equal rows. Exactly TWELVE cells, and each cell contains exactly TWO separated boots forming one left-and-right pair. Each boot must have a clean gap from its partner so a game renderer can crop and move the two feet independently. Place the pair side by side horizontally, not overlapping and not behind one another. Consistent floor baseline inside each cell, generous transparent gutters around every pair, no cells overlap.
Image 1 is row 1 boots-dawn, image 2 row 2 boots-path, image 3 row 3 boots-star. Faithfully preserve the rich original designs, materials and colors. Row 1: pale mint and warm ivory short lace-up boots, mint leather panels, small gold leaf appliqués, clear dew-drop gems, ivory ribbon laces, tan stitched soles. Row 2: sturdy cognac-brown leather and dark moss-green textile hiking boots, sage laces, cream padded collars, brass hardware, gold leaf charm on the appropriate outer side, thick ochre lug soles. Row 3: original taller purple and blue-violet star boots with large layered rich panels, pale ivory collars and laces, curved silver/lavender inlay strips, gold constellation/star charms, pearl clasps, richly sculpted ivory lug soles. Preserve tall shafts and elaborate panels; do not shrink them into basic shoes.
Columns left to right: FRONT view, BACK view, RIGHT SIDE view (both toes toward screen-right), LEFT SIDE view (both toes toward screen-left). These must be four genuine views of the same pair, independently rendered, not a mirrored image or a repeated three-quarter product shot. The back shows heels, heel seams and rear pull-tabs, not front laces. In both side-profile columns show two separated full side profiles: one is the outer face of the right boot and one is the inner face of the left boot; preserve the asymmetrical external charms instead of copying them onto the wrong face. Do not add legs, skin or trousers. The empty ankle opening has a shaded real lining, with true transparent holes where appropriate.
Style: detailed painterly-realistic luminous fantasy product rendering like the references, tactile leather grain and textile weave, stitched edges and dimensional jewelry. Clean bright neutral studio light, complete silhouettes, exact footwear only. True alpha transparent background; no opaque white/grey, no checkerboard paint, no scenic background, no pedestal, no floor or cast shadow, no text, no lines, no labels, no logos.

Use case: identity-preserve / fantasy game wearable jewelry atlas.
Create a high resolution 2048 by 1536 PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background. A precise four-column by three-row atlas containing exactly twelve fully isolated ornate wearable brooches, one complete brooch per cell, with generous clear gutters. No text, no grid, no scenery, no pedestals, no display stands, no loose unrelated objects, no cast shadow and no opaque backdrop.
Use input images 1, 2, 3 as faithful design references for the three rows:
ROW 1, badge-seed: the original delicate golden open oval botanical brooch, two jade-mint translucent sprouting leaves, ivory/jade seed at the bottom, climbing gold vines and tiny cream five-petal blossoms, dangling clear dew jewel. Preserve open negative spaces and luminous dimensional stone.
ROW 2, badge-prism: the original large faceted CYAN / AQUAMARINE elongated diamond crystal in a sculpted gold scrollwork setting with leaves, cream flowers, small aqua gem nodes and dangling aqua teardrops. This must visibly be a real clear faceted cyan crystal with rainbow refraction, not a circular seal, flat emblem, invented book, or green leaf disc.
ROW 3, badge-sage: the original golden open-book and laurel brooch, luminous emerald oval above the book, thin orbital golden rings with creamy pearls, tiny star/compass on top, emerald teardrop bottom, ivory and gold botanical pages with engraved details. Keep this rich 3D construction and proportions.
COLUMN order is FRONT, BACK, TRUE RIGHT PROFILE, TRUE LEFT PROFILE. Each is a genuine physical view of the same brooch, not a mirrored or repeated frontal logo. Front shows the reference face; back shows its physically believable gold rear cage, engraved rear plate and small horizontal pin/hinge while respecting the overall silhouette and crystal structure; side profiles show the deep gemstone facets, raised gold mount, layered book/leaf thickness, and rear pin. RIGHT and LEFT must show the correct opposite side constructions and pendant occlusions, not the same picture flipped. No front-facing gemstone pasted onto all four views.
Materials and style: polished high-end painterly-realistic fantasy jewelry matching the references, detailed gold metal, smooth translucent jade, sharp aquamarine refraction, layered gold leaf, nacre pearls, realistic highlights. Keep tiny apertures truly transparent, edges crisp and antialiased. Bright neutral studio light. Render every object fully inside its cell with no cropped pendants.

revisions.prompt:
Edit this transparent clothing atlas ONLY to fix spacing and clipping, while preserving the exact twelve rich garment designs and material quality. Re-layout the same twelve garments in a rigorously evenly spaced FOUR-COLUMN THREE-ROW grid on a high-resolution transparent PNG, square canvas. Each object and its full garment hem must fit well INSIDE its own equal rectangular grid cell. Keep at least 12% of each cell empty along left and right, and at least 8% empty along top and bottom. Shrink objects uniformly as necessary: absolutely no object may touch the canvas edge, another object, or cross a cell boundary. There must be broad straight transparent lanes between all four columns and all three rows, wide enough for rectangular crops without neighboring garment pixels.
The rows stay pale mint short cape, forest green LONG botanical cloak, violet LONG star cloak. Preserve the longer proportions of the green and purple garments relative to their shoulders, but scale the rendered product to fit the cell. Columns stay front, back, genuine right side, genuine left side. Keep their velvet, cloth weave, fine gold embroidery, dimensional leaves, crystals, cream/green/lavender satin lining, deep natural folds and genuine independent side views. No new design, no simplification, no icons. Keep every hem, collar, clasp and pendant complete and uncropped. Exact alpha transparency around objects and in open holes. No drawn grid, no labels, no checkerboard, no opaque backdrop, no shadows outside the object.

Repair this transparent boot atlas for an animated character rig. Preserve these exact three boot designs and their high-detail materials. The important correction is COUNT and SPACING: output EXACTLY TWENTY-FOUR individual separated boots, arranged as EIGHT equal columns and THREE equal rows. One individual boot per grid cell, never a pair in one cell. High-resolution landscape PNG with a genuine transparent alpha background. There must be large clear gutters and 10% internal padding around every boot, and no boot touches or overlaps its neighbor or any canvas edge.
Rows: 1 mint/ivory morning boots with gold leaves/dew crystals; 2 moss/cognac hiking boots with padded collars, brass eyes, sage laces, leaf charm; 3 the tall rich blue-violet/purple star boots with ivory laces/collar/soles, elaborate silver curved inlay panels, gold stars and pearl hardware.
There are EIGHT ordered columns in EACH row:
1. anatomically RIGHT boot, direct FRONT view.
2. anatomically LEFT boot, direct FRONT view.
3. anatomically LEFT boot, direct BACK view.
4. anatomically RIGHT boot, direct BACK view.
5. anatomically RIGHT boot, RIGHT side view, toe points screen-RIGHT: show its OUTER side with the original charms.
6. anatomically LEFT boot, RIGHT side view, toe points screen-RIGHT: show its INNER side with proper seam construction and no falsely duplicated outer charm.
7. anatomically LEFT boot, LEFT side view, toe points screen-LEFT: show its OUTER side with original charms.
8. anatomically RIGHT boot, LEFT side view, toe points screen-LEFT: show its INNER side with proper seam construction.
Every row must contain all eight boots, including four separate side-profile boots, for a total of 24. Do not collapse the side profiles to one boot per direction. Keep all shoes upright, complete, at a common baseline within each row, and approximately the same physical scale within each row. Render genuine different views rather than mirroring artwork. Keep detailed leather grain, textile, stitches and dimensional gems. No legs, no skin, no trousers, no pedestals, no text, no grid lines, no labels, no background or drop shadow.

Technical production edit, preserve exactly these twelve garment designs and their faithful rich material details. ONLY rearrange and REDUCE their size to create a usable non-overlapping atlas. Output landscape 4:3 high-resolution PNG on transparent alpha. FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, twelve objects. Every object must be SMALLER within its cell than in this input: no object's bounding rectangle may exceed 18% of the TOTAL image width or 25% of the TOTAL image height. The cell centers are at x=12.5%, 37.5%, 62.5%, 87.5%; row centers y=16.67%, 50%, 83.33%. Center each complete garment on one of those twelve points. Between columns there must be completely transparent vertical lanes at least 7% of total image width, and between rows completely transparent lanes at least 8% of total image height. Even the very wide purple hems must stay narrow enough to leave those lanes, with no single thread or sparkle entering another garment's bounding rectangle. Do not enlarge to fill the canvas.
Keep the twelve exact shown clothes in the same order: row1 mint short cape, row2 forest-green long botanical cloak, row3 violet long star cloak; columns front/back/real right profile/real left profile. Preserve cloak proportions, full complete unclipped hems, gold embroidery, cloth weave, velvet, satin lining, chains, gemstones, folds. No design change, no low-detail simplification. No characters, hangers, grid lines, numbers, text, labels, shadows, checkerboard, or opaque scenery. The only change is making the garments smaller and regularly separated on actual alpha transparency.

Use case: background-extraction. Remove ONLY the opaque blurry beige/green/purple background from this image and replace it with a genuinely transparent alpha channel. Keep ALL TWENTY-FOUR boots exactly as they are: same design, colors, details, silhouettes, positions, dimensions, four different views with distinct inner/outer sides, and current eight-column three-row arrangement. Keep each boot complete. Retain every lace, charm, leather detail, lining and sole. No design changes and no rearrangement. Remove the background fully from every gap between boots and around the canvas, do not replace it with white, gray, black, a painted checkerboard, fog, or shadows. This is a game sprite atlas that needs actual transparency. No new text or objects.
